article.title: Huh? Will Cain Digs Up Old Clips to Argue Trump Has ‘Stayed Consistent’ in Opposing Long Wars
article.description:
Will Cain dug up some old clips to argue Donald Trump has remained consistent in his opposition to foreign wars as he faces backlash over his Iran strikes.
